Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
Letter of Recommendation
LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION
Our ref: 118
31 Mar 2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Handpump Installation — Uttar Pradesh Pkg-134” (Rs.
480.00 Lakh), completed on 27 Dec 2024. On the basis of that engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction. Their performance on schedule,
quality, and safety was commendable.
Verification: Gautam Sen, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
